VbaCode:
CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
' ============================================================================
'  frmClientServiceNeedDetail
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  Popup detail form for a single tblClientServiceNeeds row.
'  Opened acDialog from any list box that lists service needs.
'
'  RecordSource:  tblClientServiceNeeds
'  PopUp:         True
'  Modal:         True            (caller also passes acDialog)
'  BorderStyle:   3  (Dialog)
'
'  OpenArgs convention:
'     "ADD|ClientID=123|FiscalYear=2025"   ? Add mode with parent context
'     "<numericID>"                         ? Edit mode for that ID
'
'  Controls (prefixed naming):
'     txtClientServiceNeedID    (PK)
'     txtClientID               (locked ? set from context in Add mode)
'     cboServiceID              (combo ? row source set in Form_Load)
'     txtFiscalYear             (locked ? set from context in Add mode)
'     txtPriority               (default 1; range 1-5)
'     txtDaysOfWeek
'     txtPreferredTimeStart
'     txtPreferredTimeEnd
'     txtHoursPerWeek           (>0 and <=168)
'     txtNotes
'     btnSave / btnCancel / btnDelete
'
'  Note: the "PreferredTimeStart < PreferredTimeEnd" constraint is enforced
'  at the table level via a Validation Rule. Access surfaces the table's
'  Validation Text on save ? no form-level check needed.
' ============================================================================
Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim args As Variant
    args = Me.OpenArgs
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(args) Then
        Me.DataEntry = True
    ElseIf IsNumeric(Nz(args, "")) Then
        Me.Filter = "ClientServiceNeedID=" & CLng(args)
        Me.FilterOn = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Load()
    ' Service combo. Row source set in code (no design-view row source).
    Me.cboServiceID.RowSource = _
        "SELECT ServiceID, ServiceName FROM tblServices " & _
        "WHERE IsActive=True ORDER BY ServiceName"
    Me.cboServiceID.ColumnCount = 2
    Me.cboServiceID.ColumnWidths = "0;2.5 in"
    Me.cboServiceID.BoundColumn = 1
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(Me.OpenArgs) Then
        Dim cid As Long, fy As Long
        cid = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "ClientID")
        fy = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "FiscalYear")
        If cid > 0 Then Me!ClientID = cid
        If fy > 0 Then Me!FiscalYear = fy
        If IsNull(Me!Priority) Then Me!Priority = 1
        Me.btnDelete.Enabled = False
        Me.Caption = "New Service Need"
    Else
        Me.btnDelete.Enabled = True
        Me.Caption = "Edit Service Need"
    End If
    ' Identity columns are not user-editable in this dialog.
    Me.txtClientID.Locked = True
    Me.txtFiscalYear.Locked = True
End Sub
Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    If IsNull(Me!ServiceID) Then
        MsgBox "Please select a service.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.cboServiceID.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsNull(Me!HoursPerWeek) Or Me!HoursPerWeek <= 0 Then
        MsgBox "Hours per week must be greater than zero.", _
               vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtHoursPerWeek.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Me!HoursPerWeek > 168 Then
        MsgBox "Hours per week cannot exceed 168.", _
               vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtHoursPerWeek.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Nz(Me!Priority, 0) < 1 Or Nz(Me!Priority, 0) > 5 Then
        MsgBox "Priority must be between 1 and 5.", _
               vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtPriority.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' Note: PreferredTimeStart < PreferredTimeEnd is enforced by the
    ' table validation rule. We let Access surface that one.
    ' Duplicate check (same client + service + FY).
    Dim selfID As Long
    selfID = Nz(Me!ClientServiceNeedID, 0)
    If DCount("*", "tblClientServiceNeeds", _
              "ClientID=" & Me!ClientID & _
              " AND ServiceID=" & Me!ServiceID & _
              " AND FiscalYear=" & Me!FiscalYear & _
              " AND ClientServiceNeedID<>" & selfID) > 0 Then
        MsgBox "A need for this service in this fiscal year already " & _
               "exists for this client.", _
               vbExclamation, "Duplicate"
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False    ' fires Form_BeforeUpdate (and table rules)
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    ' Validation canceled the save (form-level BeforeUpdate or table rule).
    ' Surface the error so the user sees why the save was blocked.
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Validation"
End Sub
Private Sub btnCancel_Click()
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.Undo
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name, acSaveNo
End Sub
Private Sub btnDelete_Click()
    If Me.NewRecord Then Exit Sub
    ' Block delete if any plan rows reference this need.
    Dim inUse As Long
    inUse = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", _
                   "ClientServiceNeedID=" & Me!ClientServiceNeedID)
    If inUse > 0 Then
        MsgBox "Cannot delete this need." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
               inUse & " service plan row(s) reference it. " & _
               "Remove or reassign those plans first.", _
               vbExclamation, "Need In Use"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If MsgBox("Delete this service need?", _
              vbYesNo + vbQuestion + vbDefaultButton2, _
              "Confirm Delete") = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo Failed
    RunCommand acCmdSelectRecord
    RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    MsgBox "Could not delete: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "Delete Failed"
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Combo niceties
' ============================================================================
Private Sub cboServiceID_NotInList(NewData As String, Response As Integer)
    If MsgBox("Service '" & NewData & "' is not in the list." & vbCrLf & _
              "Add it now?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Add Service?") = vbYes Then
        Response = acDataErrAdded
        DoCmd.OpenForm "frmServiceDetail", , , , acFormAdd, acDialog
        Me.cboServiceID.Requery
    Else
        Response = acDataErrContinue
    End If
End Sub
